fact: SPACEBEL says it signed contracts on 16 June 2026 with the DRC Ministry of Higher Education, Universities, Scientific Research and Innovation to supply and maintain the RDC-SAT Earth observation satellite supporting the National Centre for Remote Sensing, which it says will help manage natural resources including agriculture.

Kinshasa Times reports that the Centre national de teledetection, with JICA, held the first coordination committee of a project to equip the centre to analyse satellite data and supply it to the agriculture, mining and environment ministries.

AXA Climate says the DRC Ministry of Agriculture underwrites a parametric climate insurance product for up to 300,000 farmers in three provinces, to be launched from 2025 and triggered by satellite rainfall indices (TAMSAT and ERA5).
